library_purpose: Private, rebuildable local research records for source identity and material references, observed work units, method atoms, applicability and actual downstream use.

canonical_records.source: sources/SRC-<16 uppercase hexadecimal digits>.json (includes source_material reference, version and read scope; authorized captured excerpts live here once)
canonical_records.source_link: .source-links/SRC-<id>.json (source_id and owner_library relative to the collection, referring to the canonical source in another receiving Skill or the legacy root)
canonical_records.atom_link: .atom-links/ATM-<id>.json (atom_id, category and owner_library relative to the collection; preserves discovery and original IDs when an atom is stored in another library)

derived_cache.read_behavior: info and query are read-only; they do not build, repair or rebuild caches
derived_cache.managed_updates: put and explicit rebuild-index maintain the selected library's catalog and compatible category indexes

categories: Choose a receiving library under SKILL.md > 选择研究库. Reuse categories by the primary professional purpose or the user's assignment. Save an independent atom in the Skill that consumes it and share a single source by reference. Reuse an atom across consumer bindings where applicable. Create a concise lowercase category when its first authorized record is written.
privacy: Keep source, atom and usage records local by default. Share only after reviewing each record and destination.
